result.title: Towards Understanding the Impact of Plasticity Loss on Reinforcement Learning in Stochastic Environments
result.comment: 9 pages main paper, 15 pages references and appendix, 17 figures. Presented at the Nineteenth European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning (EWRL 2026)
result.summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework for sequential decision-making. Despite many high-profile successes in recent years, deep RL is known to be brittle. An emerging line of research attributes this brittleness to a loss of plasticity in neural networks. However, plasticity loss has so far been understudied in stochastic environments. We study this interplay systematically, training SAC agents on three DeepMind Control tasks augmented with controlled levels of observation and action noise. We find that plasticity-preserving methods increase learning robustness on the two harder tasks, with their advantage growing as observation noise increases, while combining resets with layer normalization underperforms resets alone at every observation noise level tested. Further, stochasticity can accelerate the loss of plasticity in harder environments, whereas in easier settings noise can act as a regularizer that sustains plasticity. Lastly, plasticity loss is most pronounced in the early stages of training. In the most challenging stochastic settings, TD instability rather than gradual plasticity loss becomes the dominant failure mode.

AI.brief_summary: 该文系统考察随机环境下的可塑性丧失问题：在三个 DeepMind Control 任务上加入可控的观测与动作噪声训练 SAC，比较保持可塑性的方法，并分析噪声水平、重置与 LayerNorm 组合以及 TD 不稳定的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 可塑性丧失、重置与归一化的组合以及「后期由 TD 不稳定主导失败」等结论，或可为 LVR 中循环/长序列训练的稳定性与贡献分配提供可核查的训练侧线索，但本文不涉及视觉或 latent 推理状态，联系较弱。
